distill_validation.coherent_design_unit: whole pre-action boundary preserving separation among gates, actor protocol, evaluator, receipt, and effect

effort techniques consensus and schema validity do not supply truth or authority

observer.note: The design challenger required manifest-candidate rather than final-applicability inputs for technique selection, evaluator ownership of observation admission and receipt assembly, and an explicit zero-call entry-flag route. All were corrected before plan release.
